Follow a card’s journey
01 / A card in your hand

Point at a card. Pianke does the rest.

It auto-detects the edges, straightens the image, then recognizes the text and parses it into fields — all on-device. Got it wrong? Just edit, or fix the raw text and re-parse.

  • Name, company, title, phone, email, address, website in one pass
  • Phones auto-typed: mobile / work / fax
  • Edit the raw OCR text, then re-parse
02 / Find the person again

Remember the company. Find the person.

The library collects colleagues from one company into a single card, so your network reads at a glance. Search instantly by name, company, phone, email, or your own tags.

  • Auto-grouped by company; blank ones go to “No company”
  • Custom tags (VIP / client / vendor), searchable
  • Long-press to multi-select for batch actions
03 / Keep the conversation going

You met.
Remember what comes next.

Add a note about where you met and what you discussed. Set a follow-up reminder, so the next conversation starts with a little context.

A note to your future self

Met at the expo. Send the product introduction next week.

FAQ

Questions, answered.

Not covered here? See the support page.

Does Pianke upload my cards?

No. Scanning, recognition and storage all happen on your phone. The Android app doesn't even request the internet permission, and the iPhone / iPad app contains no networking code at all.

Do I need an account?

No. Open the app and start; there is no sign-in screen.

With no internet permission, how do I buy Pro?

Google Play or the App Store handles the purchase itself, and the app never sees your payment details. After a new phone or a reinstall, tap “Restore purchase” with the same store account to get Pro back.

How do I move my cards to a new phone?

Export a backup file in Settings (plain, or encrypted with a password) and import it on the new phone. Backup files work between Android and iPhone / iPad, and you keep the file yourself.

What does the free version include?

Free keeps up to 15 cards, and every core feature is included. Pro is a one-time US$14.99 that removes the limit — not a subscription. Store price may vary by region.

Does Pro carry over between Android and iPhone?

Sorry, it doesn't. A purchase belongs to the store account it was made with, so Pro bought on Google Play doesn't unlock the iPhone / iPad app, and vice versa. Your cards can still move over with a backup file.

Which devices and card languages are supported?

Android 8.0 or later, and iPhone / iPad on iOS 17 or later. It reads Chinese and English cards, recognized offline on the phone.
